resumeText: Kenji Watanabe is a Data Scientist at Summit AI Lab with three years of experience. He joined as a machine learning intern and converted to a full-time scientist, building Scikit-learn and deep learning models in Python with Pandas for research-driven projects. He is strong at modeling and prototyping but lacks SQL, relies on teammates for data access, and has limited formal statistics training for rigorous experimentation.
